top: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness,
bottom: in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven...

top: Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ,
bottom: and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

top: ...the Lord stood by him, and said,
To open their eyes, and to turn them
bottom: from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan...

top: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ:
bottom: for it is the power of God unto salvation...

top: For the wages of sin is death;
bottom: but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
